title: The Box Model and Overflow Handling
description: Master the CSS box model, padding, borders, margins, and overflow to build structured layouts and avoid common spacing issues.

lessons.title: What is the CSS Box Model?
lessons.content: The CSS box model includes the content, padding, border, and margin. Every HTML element is considered a rectangular box.

lessons.title: Understanding Content, Padding, Border, Margin
lessons.content: Content is the innermost area. Padding is space around content. Border surrounds the padding. Margin is the outer space between elements.

Practical Box Model Debugging Tips
lessons.content: Use browser dev tools to inspect spacing, enable element outlines for visual help, and always set `box-sizing: border-box` globally for consistency.
